show.description: Betrayed by her husband Manav and best friend Fiza, pregnant Gauri is left for dead after a staged accident. But she survives, returns with a new face and identity, and teams up with her twin sister Aarti to destroy those who shattered her life. In a high-stakes game of love, lies, and vengeance, Gauri’s silent fury becomes their loudest nightmare. Watch Now!
